status: METADATA_ONLY_SOURCE_SCREEN; NO BIOLOGICAL RESPONSE FILE ACCESSED
relation_to_mainline: Independent external descriptive state-axis replication candidate, not an extension or rescue of the frozen Tampa next-year early-warning endpoint.

source.name: Charlotte Harbor Seagrass Monitoring (Florida SEACAR Program 570)
source.publisher: Florida Department of Environmental Protection, Office of Resilience and Coastal Protection, Charlotte Harbor Aquatic Preserves
source.declared_sampling: Fixed transects with recurring stations, regularly spaced 1 m x 1 m quadrats; beginning and end of meadow may change among years
source.declared_access: Download portal asks for valid email and registration; do not bypass, impersonate or claim download

must_verify_before_response_access: The original workbook/version and accompanying metadata document identify an unambiguous stable transect ID over years.
Identify true surveyed species absence separately from unreported/missing species records.
Identify repeat sampled-quadrat or meter-mark IDs; if not stable, use transect-year only and do not assert point-level continuity.
Identify measured area and units for shoot counts and blade length and any changes in definitions/protocols.
Distinguish Program 570 records from Estero Bay/other programs 5721/571 and documented excluded stations.
Document survey date/day-of-year, number of sampled quadrats and incomplete visits.
Record exact supplied file SHA256 and unmodified provenance before viewing outcome columns.
pre_response_documentation_gate.failure: STOP_SCHEMA_OR_IDENTITY_UNRESOLVED; do not improvise respondent-dependent ID joins or replace missing with zero.

hypothesis: Within established long-term Thalassia transects, recorded focal presence may remain positive across sampled years while plant stature, shoot density, or species-specific abundance changes; signs and magnitudes need not agree among subregions.

analysis_scope.stable_unit: Program 570 stable transect x calendar survey year, one annual aggregated record per stable transect, with documented within-year repeat rule
analysis_scope.positive: At least one explicitly sampled quadrat has a positive, numeric focal Braun-Blanquet entry; verify source-specific encoding before assigning
analysis_scope.absence: Only an explicitly sampled, complete focal-negative unit after inspection of the complete species and effort roster; never infer from missing species rows
quantitative_states: focal BB aggregate over all sampled quadrats after verifying documented convention
mean focal blade length among eligible measured plants
focal shoot count per known sampled area
analysis_scope.primary_cohort_gate: At least 20 independently identified eligible transects with at least 5 annual sampled years each in 2016-2025, with usable positive-year quantitative observations for the targeted response; otherwise report NON_ESTIMABLE.
analysis_scope.effort_gate: Record sampled quadrat count/area per site-year; do not pool incomparable units or changes of protocol without a documented harmonization.
analysis_scope.comparison: Report stable-identity-adjusted trends and node-bootstrap 95% intervals for both plant dimensions, stratified by documented subregions; report full signs, non-significant results and spatial counterexamples.
analysis_scope.multiple_outcomes: Holm-adjust the two primary plant-dimension tests; focal BB and composition are secondary.
caveats: An observed positive year is not a guarantee of survival of the same genet.
Conditioning on recorded presence can create selection bias; report all eligible positive-year denominators.
Differences between sources in protocol and taxonomy may prevent harmonization.
No universal serial condition-to-thinning-to-loss sequence is asserted.

prohibited_moves: Do not infer causal reserve buffering, resilience debt, mortality, or restoration benefit from annual association.
Do not claim predictive external replication from a descriptive result.
Do not alter the prior Tampa or SeagrassNet/MarineGEO frozen endpoints or stop rules.
Do not retrospectively select favorable subregions, metrics or years.
Do not use SEACAR download credentials or a user's personal email without explicit user authorization.
next_status: Await lawful registered source access plus independent variable-schema and stable-ID preflight.
